mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the systematic steps and approaches used to put planned health promotion activities into action and make them accessible to the target population."

Strategies for implementing health programmes refer to the systematic steps and approaches used to put planned health promotion activities into action and make them accessible to the target population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the apex body responsible for national health policy formulation, regulation, planning, and coordination."
Federal Ministry of Health (FMOH) is the apex body responsible for national health policy formulation, regulation, planning, and coordination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the 6-week (42-day) period after delivery during which the reproductive organs return to their pre-pregnancy state."
The Puerperium is the 6-week (42-day) period after delivery during which the reproductive organs return to their pre-pregnancy state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the formal arrangement of roles, authority, responsibilities, and communication channels within an institution or system."
Organisational structure refers to the formal arrangement of roles, authority, responsibilities, and communication channels within an institution or system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to adjust to varied situations with a sense of purpose."
Mental Dimension Mental health is the ability to adjust to varied situations with a sense of purpose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to population-based and individual-based interventions aimed at minimising disease burden and associated risk factors."
Disease prevention refers to population-based and individual-based interventions aimed at minimising disease burden and associated risk factors.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a planned, organised set of health- related activities designed to improve the health and well-being of individuals and groups within a specific community."
A Community Health Programme is a planned, organised set of health- related activities designed to improve the health and well-being of individuals and groups within a specific community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the increasing interdependence of nations."
Globalisation and Health Globalisation is the increasing interdependence of nations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of restoring a person's social identity by helping them repossess their normal roles in society."
Rehabilitation is the process of restoring a person's social identity by helping them repossess their normal roles in society.
